_readme: EXAMPLE: Browan TBWL100 water-leak sensor. Not read by the service; copy from here.
1. Copy the block under "devices" into the "devices" object of server/python/devices.json.
2. Replace the devEUI keys (lowercase, 16 hex chars) with your sensors', and change name and ntfy_topic.
3. "family" must be the ChirpStack device-profile name: Browan Water sensor.
4. Secrets stay as ${ENV_VAR} placeholders; export LORALARM_PUSHOVER_USER / LORALARM_PUSHOVER_TOKEN.
5. Save devices.json: it is hot-reloaded, no restart. Wet the probe to test.
Everything except name and family is optional; the type's defaults fill the gaps.
No threshold/frequency/duration here: this device has no downlink settings.
A wet sensor raises Vattenläcka once, however often it re-sends; the next dry frame clears it.
watchdog_hours: the sensor sends a keep-alive every 60 min, so 3 h catches a dead sensor quickly.
batt_*: 3.6 V Li-SOCl2 cell (datasheet 3.6 V max / 3.1 V min), warn/empty limits are an assumption;
No alarm_window: a leak is worth a message day and night. Add "alarm_window" to a device to change that.
